WPSS No. 419 of 2020
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
(Through V.C.)
1. Mr. Anil Anthwal, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Devendra Bora, learned 
Standing Counsel for the State.
3. Petitioner retired in the year 2019 
but up till date post retiral dues including 
gratuity have not been paid. Learned 
Standing Counsel apprise to this Court 
that criminal proceeding for the offence 
punishable under Section 409 IPC is still 
going on and because of this the benefits 
have not been given.
4. Let State may justify their stand 
whether on this ground they can 
withhold post retiral benefits including 
gratuity.
5. Put up this matter on 11.09.2025.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) 
02.09.2025
Parul
